text:
maya: heads-up — noticed console is coercing quoted scalars into numbers when saving routing yaml. e.g. '010' -> 10 and it breaks header-match rules in prod.

daniel: ahhh that's bad. can you paste a tiny repro?

maya: minimal snippet below (saved via console editor):
```yaml
routes:
  - id: users-by-region
    match:
      headers:
        X-Client-Weight:
          exact: true
          values: ['01']
```
when we save in console it POSTs the config and the stored route shows values: [1] (no quotes). routing service treats that as number and header compare fails.

rachel: is the coercion happening in the frontend YAML -> JS parser or in the backend config API?

maya: quick bisect: if i curl the same YAML directly to the api server it preserves the quotes. looks like Console's client-side YAML parser (js-yaml) is doing implicit number typing.

jon: js-yaml default will convert '01' -> 1 unless you use schema: FAILSAFE or set `json: true`. we had similar bug for env var parsing a while back.

priya: UX/ops question: should console block save on type coercion? or just warn and show diff?

daniel: i'd prefer not to be breaking. flow: make it a lint warning + visual diff that shows the parser changed types. blocker only if the schema type is strict and we can't recover.

maya: agreed. proposed plan:
- short term: make Console parser use js-yaml with json: true or custom schema to preserve quoted scalars.
- add a lint rule in the authoring pipeline that flags scalar type changes between user-edited YAML and canonicalized JSON (non-blocking by default).
- backend schema: update JSON Schema for header match values to accept string OR number explicitly (oneOf) to avoid immediate validation errors for existing customers.

rachel: note: allowing both types in schema is defensive but hides real mismatches. we should also include an annotation `raw_yaml_scalar: "'01'"` in the frontend diff so users know the original form.

jon: on tests — i'll add unit tests for console parser roundtrip and e2e that saves via console -> fetches config -> compares raw yaml preview. add CI check to fail if coercion changes a scalar type for header matcher fields.

priya: for the Console UX: can we show an inline banner on save: "We detected type changes in these fields: X-Client-Weight (original: '01', saved: 1)." with a "Keep original" toggle?

maya: yes. implementation note: the console already computes a preview diff for route changes. reuse that UI and add an extra column "original_scalar" with the raw YAML snippet.

daniel: i've opened a tracking ticket and a draft PR: https://git.redwood.local/infra/console/pulls/3427 (WIP). chore-bot will post CI status.

chore-bot: PR 3427 created by @daniel — status: draft.

rachel: security note: make sure K8s configmaps / helm templating steps don't re-coerce values later in the pipeline. we've bitten this before when helm's value parsing turned '000' into 0. add integration smoke to dedicated deploy pipeline.

jon: timeline: aim for non-blocking lint + parser fix in next minor (this week). schema relax + CI tests next sprint. blocking validation only if we see real user incidents.

maya: will add a small reproducer service that emits routes and header-matches to show end-to-end mismatch. leaving TODOs in PR.

priya: thanks — can someone drop an RFC note in docs/authoring about the new lint rule and the "Keep original" toggle? that'll help SREs and customer-support when they triage routing mismatches.

daniel: added to the PR description and created a docs stub: docs/authoring/yaml-scalar-handling.md (WIP).

maya: awesome. ping me if you need the test YAMLs.

jon: grabbing them now.

chore-bot: PR 3427 status: pipeline started.
